zh: 五十音词库现在有自己的样子：打开它不再是一行一词的列表，而是一张五列十一行的五十音图——あ行到わ行按行排、あいうえお按段排，每格一个假名配罗马字，左侧一小段色条照旧表示这个音的复习状态。や行、わ行和末尾的「ん」按标准留白，删掉某个音也不会把整张图塌回列表，那一格会变成变暗的占位。搜索或按状态筛选时会自动回到列表，方便看清命中项。其它词本和闪卡完全不受影响。另外修好了安卓手机上点「发音」没声音的问题：现在朗读能正常出声，设置里也能看到并切换音色；万一设备确实没有可用的朗读引擎，发音按钮会如实收起，不再让你等一个永远不来的声音。
en: The kana wordbooks now have a layout of their own: opening one shows a proper gojūon chart instead of a flat list of rows — five vowel columns, eleven consonant rows, one kana per cell with its romaji, and the same short study-status stripe on the left. The blank cells in the ya, wa and final n rows stay blank, and deleting one kana keeps the chart intact with a dimmed placeholder instead of collapsing back into a list. Searching or filtering by status falls back to the list so the matches stay readable. Other wordbooks and the flashcards are unchanged. We also fixed pronunciation on Android: tapping speak now actually produces sound and the voice list in Settings works; if a device genuinely has no usable speech engine, the speak controls are hidden rather than leaving you waiting for audio that will never arrive.
